execution_semantics_corrected_at: 2026-07-10 after independent review; entry now uses the 16:30 kline open rather than the preceding kline close

source.title: Bitcoin intraday time series momentum
source.source_rule_note: The paper's first timing strategy is long the last half-hour when ONFH is positive and short when ONFH is negative. This v1 is a predeclared long/flat Binance proxy, not an exact replication.

session.dst_policy: America/New_York civil time; intentional proxy deviation from the paper's EST wording
session.signal_return: close at current session 09:30 ET divided by close at prior session 17:00 ET minus one
session.trade_return: close of the 16:30-17:00 ET kline divided by that kline's 16:30 ET open minus one

trading_rule.position: long 1.0 BTCUSDT when triggered; otherwise flat
trading_rule.entry: open of the 16:30-17:00 ET kline after signal is known

costs.cost_application: subtract one round trip only on triggered sessions

holdout_policy: Do not download or evaluate a later partition unless every preceding partition passes unchanged gates. If development fails, do not invert the signal, add the short side, change clocks, add volume/volatility filters, switch instruments, or inspect later partitions on this specification.
